member.name: T:RicherComponents.DatePickerControl.RichDatePicker
member.summary: The RichDatePicker control is an easy to use, multi-browser control that will allow you to easily add date selection to your web forms. For DHTML enabled browsers (Internet Explorer 5+ and Netscape 6+), the calendar is displayed within the current window. For non DHTML enabled browsers (Internet Explorer 4 and Netscape 4), the calendar is displayed as three drop down lists (Day/Month/Year). Both calendars are dynamically generated by Javascript and displayed.
member.remarks:
Use the RichDatePicker control to display a single month of a calendar on a web page using DHTML and Javascript. The control allows you to easily select a particular date, which is then displayed in either a textbox or label control.
By default the control displays the a textbox and button. If the client is using a newer browser that allows for DHTML, a calendar layer will be displayed once the button is clicked. If the client is using a non-supported browser, a new window will open containing the calendar.

example.code: <%@ Register TagPrefix="RDP" Assembly="RichDatePicker" Namespace="RicherComponents.DatePickerControl" %> <html> <head> </head> <body> <form runat="server"> <RDP:RichDatePicker id="richdatePicker1" runat="server" ControlDisplay="TextboxImage" Text="Change Date" ImageUrl="~/images/calendar.gif"> <MonthHeaderStyle BackColor="red" ForeColor="black" /> <DayHeaderStyle BackColor="orange" ForeColor="black" /> <WeekdayStyle BackColor="white" ForeColor="black" /> <WeekendStyle BackColor="lightgrey" ForeColor="black" /> </RDP:RichDatePicker> </form> </body> </html>

member.name: P:RicherComponents.DatePickerControl.RichDatePicker.DateFormatting
member.summary: This gets or sets how the control output date. Default value will defined by selected Culture. d or D - The day of the month. Single-digit days will not have a leading zero. dd or DD - The day of the month. Single-digit days will have a leading zero. M - The numeric month. Single-digit months will not have a leading zero. MM - The numeric month. Single-digit months will have a leading zero. MMM - The first 3 char of the month name, as defined in MMMM - The full name of the month, as defined in yy or YY - The year without the century. Only for 20 and 19 century. yyyy or YYYY - The full year.
member.value: The default value for this property define output date formatting by selected Culture.
